chunks: And in the narration of al-Hasan ibn 'Ali al-Washsha' from Hammad ibn 'Uthman from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, he said:
Whoever bequeaths one-third has harmed the heirs, and bequeathing one-fifth or one-fourth is better than bequeathing one-third.
And he said: Whoever bequeaths one-third has not left anything behind.

key_terms.الثُّلُثِ: one-third of the estate allocated as a bequest
key_terms.الْوَرَثَةِ: the legal heirs of the deceased

ai.seo_question: What amount of bequest is recommended in Shia hadith, and is bequeathing one-third disliked?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance on the recommended amount of a bequest, discouraging assigning the full one-third when it would burden the heirs. It indicates that a bequest of one-fifth or one-fourth is preferable, reflecting consideration for the rights of inheritors.
